ITEM 1 | Single piece of cooked fish fillet sitting in a white foam takeout container, roughly triangular, about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide; flesh side pale yellowish-cream with light golden-green seasoning or coating flecks, skin side dark green-black and charred in patches with a slightly glossy, oily sheen; edges look flaky and slightly moist, piece is fairly thin (about 1.5 cm at thickest) and holds its shape | 110

ITEM 2 | Small dark green-brown residue or seasoning speck near the upper right edge of the fish piece, a few millimetres across, dry and matte | 2
